feature: One Flutter journey from convert registration to classroom attendance
execution_status: local app composition and integrated Chromium journey implemented; local Supabase execution is blocked; human accessibility and hosted-browser evidence remain release work
baseline: completed convert app plus ministry Supabase port
global_constraints: One Supabase Auth session, congregation identity, router and responsive Flutter shell.
Only server-enforced grants expose convert, student and referral data; UI checks are presentation only.
Conversion and classroom histories remain distinct; no automatic enrollment, baptism inference or name-only merge.
Apple-design governs UI feel, design-oo-ux adds structure, and a11y-ethics supplies privacy/POUR checks.
Pin and load the fork domain skills at origin/main@ace9e92 and route one stage skill plus applicable overlays; internal artifacts are English, UI copy pt-BR.
No private-record migration or production deployment.

tasks.title: Finalize handoff policy and shared field ownership
tasks.summary: Close the product choices needed for a safe one-to-one link before writing the promotion command.
acceptance: Role matrix states full conversion-history versus minimal-referral rights for ministry staff and specifies archived/terminal convert behavior.
Name, phone and address are initial provenance-labeled snapshots; conversion data stays convert-owned and education/baptism/enrollment stays student-owned; later edits do not silently synchronize.
One sequence diagram covers locks, authorization, existing-student review, one-to-one link, receipt replay and response loss.
An unassigned convert requires authorized congregation assignment before promotion; transfer after linking is excluded until an explicit safe rule exists.

tasks.title: Implement atomic convert-to-student linking
tasks.summary: Add one-to-one schema and idempotent server command with minimal scoped referral projection.
acceptance: Unique nullable ministry_students.convert_id and ieadpe_promote_convert_to_student(operation_id uuid,payload jsonb) enforce one link under concurrent clients, replay and lost response.
Tests cover unassigned, archived/terminal, existing same-scope student, out-of-scope candidate, revoked grant, altered payload and both commit orders; no name-only auto-merge.
Authorized minimal referral contains only declared fields; unauthorized direct join/read is denied by RLS; no enrollment or historical rewrite occurs.
Existing convert and ministry SQL suites pass after the new migration.

tasks.title: Build linked journey and ministry screens
tasks.summary: Port IEADPE pages into feature-owned widgets and expose an explicit promotion/review flow.
acceptance: An authorized user can review a convert, create/link one student, then explicitly enroll and record attendance; denied users see neither hidden data nor an enabled action.
Duplicate review uses explicit scoped candidate selection; retry preserves the operation ID and drafts survive recoverable failures without false success.

Widget regressions assert representative 360/768/1440 layouts, 200% text, keyboard focus, semantic labels/outcomes, reduced-motion settings, error recovery and no page-wide horizontal overflow; human assistive-technology and visual review remains a separate release check.
WhatsApp and other contact actions require a deliberate tap and never prefill religious data.

tasks.title: Compose one shell, theme and route guard
tasks.summary: Register ministry feature routes after dependencies land and retain convert session/cache protection.
acceptance: One root MaterialApp/session guard serves campaign and ministry routes; logout, revocation, identity switch and direct URL refresh clear protected data across both modules.

Ministry supervisors without a fixed congregation choose one explicitly from the server directory; directory loading is page-bounded and user-driven, and the client selection never replaces server authorization.
A documented token comparison selects one semantic theme; existing convert branding and IEADPE accessibility behavior are preserved or intentionally reconciled.

Route and widget tests cover scoped navigation, forbidden/not-found, local browser-history back/forward, form draft handling and no PII in query strings; hosted deep-link refresh stays a release check.
Complete convert regression, ministry repository/widget tests and analyzer pass.
